findings.title: Describe auto-end as an attempt.
codeFacts: autoEndCleanTerminal issues ONE agent_teams_control end call, with timeoutMs = stageTimeoutMs ?? STAGING_TIMEOUT_MS
a non-ok answer and a thrown/timed-out call both warn once and return false (text ends 'the gate continues')
the RULE 3 loop awaits the call and discards the boolean; autoEndAttempted makes it ONE attempt per team per process
the source comment states a failed call 'must not turn every following pre-step into a retry loop'
the re-arm/settlement branch is not conditioned on the auto-end result, so a board classified terminal can leave its team open
findings.newText: `completed`/`cancelled`, none `failed` — which the gate ATTEMPTS to end itself: `autoEndCleanTerminal` issues ONE `agent_teams_control end` call per team per process and, if that call fails or times out, logs one warning and continues WITHOUT retrying that team — so a board the gate treats as terminal can leave its team open.

findings.title: Qualify when the gate stages a shell.
findings.verifiedAgainst: packages/mpd-roles-plugin/src/session-gate.ts (symbols: stagePlan, fireReTeam, the mode table in the file header) and packages/mpd-roles-plugin/src/complexity-gate.ts (NO_TEAM_STAGED_PHRASE)
codeFacts: mode table: mechanical stages; advisory 'stages nothing'; off returns immediately
stagePlan returns {ok:true, alreadyStaged:true} when the probe finds an existing plan — nothing is created
stagePlan returns {ok:false, error} when hasStagingTool is false, or the tool call fails/throws/times out
every non-staged route emits a notice whose plan line says 'NO team was staged'
findings.newText: With no live team and `team.reteam.afterConsults` (default 4) COMPLETED `mpd_role_spawn*` / `mpd_workmate_spawn` calls since the last fire, the gate fires the re-team rule under the marker `[AgentTeams] Re-team rule`, once per record in `<ws>/.mpd/session-gate/<sessionId>.json`. It stages a NEW shell only under `team.gate=mechanical`, only when `stagePlan` succeeds, and only when the staged-plan probe found none — a plan already staged is NAMED through `alreadyStaged` instead of created, and an unanswerable probe stages anyway with one warning. `advisory` mode, a missing `agent_teams_plan` tool and every failed call emit the notice only, saying `NO team was staged`. `team.reteam.enabled` (default true) gates only that volume trigger.
